steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review the specific education and hours requirements for your background—typically a bachelor's degree plus project-management experience, or equivalent combinations. Gather documentation now to streamline your application later.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® training course. Attend all sessions from your Scottsdale location on a flexible schedule that fits your work calendar. Our active certified practitioners guide you through the PMBOK® framework, exam domains, and real-world application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the 35-hour course, complete your official PMI application online. Report your education, project experience, and training completion. Submit payment of the PMI examination fee. PMI will verify your credentials before you receive authorization to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE test center in Scottsdale or online. Plan to dedicate focused study time in the weeks leading up to your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP®, commit to a three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved continuing education, volunteer work, or authoring. Renew your credential and fees before expiration to keep your PMP® active and recognized by employers in your local job market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
